scope: Frozen QASPER dev only; 36 papers, 100 questions, 92 answerable and 8 evidence-N/A per run
source_policy: Verify every selected original row/config/source hash; freeze compact snapshot before plotting; never include test or unfinished all-corpus rows

charts.question: How do the 11 chunkers compare across BM25, Dense and Hybrid?
charts.takeaway: Quality depends on method; the declared Hybrid selection rule chose F512_O0 and R512, not the best individual Dense cell.
charts.non_color: Every cell has its numeric label; candidates marked in row labels.

charts.question: What changed when the selected candidates used neighbor expansion?
charts.takeaway: Full-reference coverage increased while continuous coverage decreased for both candidates; the frozen rule prioritizes full-reference coverage.
charts.variant: horizontal signed grouped changes in percentage points
charts.non_color: Full-reference filled bars; continuous open hatched bars; direct signed labels.

charts.question: How many child and parent records does each dev chunker create?
charts.takeaway: Parent-child layouts have additional parent mapping records; parent records are not independently embedded.
charts.variant: horizontal stacked child and parent counts
charts.non_color: Parent segment open and hatched; direct totals.

data_sufficiency: The complete fixed 11-group matrix is available. Expansion comparison deliberately has only the two frozen candidates; no extra sampling or new experiments to fill charts.
uncertainty_policy: Descriptive dev scores used for selection; no test inference or significance claims. No omitted failures; actual N/A denominators shown.
qa: Inspect exported PNGs at native readable size; compare 10 seed42 numeric cells to independent canonical interval reconstruction; confirm SVG palette and no clipped labels.
